description: Create a new item in the configured MCPVAULT. Use this when the user asks the agent to save a new password, API credential, secure note, or credit-card entry. If local automatic approval is enabled, all supported fields are approved after verification. Secret values are sent to the local 1Password CLI through stdin, not command arguments.

allowedSites.description: Allowed websites for approvals. Empty means all sites. If omitted, automatic approvals use the saved item's website; explicit single-field approvals allow all sites.

approveField.description: Field id, label, or kind for an explicit single-field approval when automatic approval is off, such as password, credential, ccnum, or credit_card_number.

approveForAgents.description: Omit to follow local automatic approval settings. False skips approval for this save. True requests the primary field when automatic approval is off; when on, all supported fields are approved.

expiry.description: Credit-card expiry in 1Password MONTH_YEAR format such as 2028/09.

requestId.description: Stable ID for this save. Reuse on retries; use a new ID only for an intentional new item. Identical input is deduplicated when omitted.

name: save_secret_item
title: Save Secret Item To 1Password
